unit: U3 puppet (cutter + hinge engineer + gesture animator + secondary dynamics)
revision: r3 build, 2026-11-16; base: plan.md round 3 + reviewed test shot r2 (archived in test-shot-r2/)
scions: #2 Lotte Reiniger articulated shadow theater (in colour)
#43 Collage graph rewriting (tile identities T1..T14 as typed props)

usage: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, PUP); import puppet as pp; pp.load_papers(PUP + '/paper')

CU head (S3/S4/S8): see build/test_shot.py draw_puppet(): pp.build_static(), pp.back_hair(wind), pp.cheeks(laugh), pp.eye_piece(kind,...), pp.brows(lift), pp.mouth_piece(id), pp.side_locks(), pp.crown_cap(), pp.fringe_pieces(strand_pts, strands); rig coords 1440x1080 = 2x of the 720x540 picture; rotate the head sheet about pp.NECK_PIN
hair: hs = pp.HairSolver(); per frame hs.step(head_ang, xform(pp.CROWN), wind, xform); hs.points(xform); carry across cuts by keeping hs (or hs.state()/hs.set_state())

full figure (S1,S2,S6,S7): img, joints = pp.render_body(pp.POSES['run3'], mouth='laugh', eye='crescent', hair=spring_value); climb: pose, pin = pp.climb_pose(k, step_top); render_body(pose, origin=...)
props: pp.tile(i, feet=False|True) (pivot bottom centre), pp.plaque(l1,l2,arr), pp.metro_sign(), pp.tunnel_rings() (6 RGBA 1440x1080 planes, front first)
all pieces pre-exported as PNG in sprites/ with sprites/manifest.json (pp.export_sprites)

palette.note: r3: skin warmed (forehead #be7c5a, cheek #ba7052, tissue #c66c4c) per user note

paper_stock_rule:
Stock rule (recorded in rig.json): skin & tissue -> thin 1928 book paper; ivory/cream (teeth, eye whites,
tiles, letters' ground) -> 1929 book paper; saturated orange collar, enamel plaques, signs -> card; hair, jumper,
shoes, mouth interior and all dark browns -> kraft.

cu_head: [head sheet, rotated on NECK_PIN:] back_hair(3 under-layers shadow/deep/dark, mid, warm, crown, lit panels, 10 slivers)
mouth (replacement: lips, interior, tongue, teeth strip w/ gap, laterals, dimples)
[world:] fringe mass (shadow union, deep union, 10 strands, lit slivers)
body: head (neck, back bob, ear, face, cheek, nose, brow, eye, mouth, front hair cap/fringe, slivers)
brass split pins at hip, knee, ankle, shoulder, elbow, wrist, neck

body.coords: body px, y down; editor scales (figure ~1000 px tall)

limit_conventions: limbs 0 = hanging down, + = forward (+x, toward the tram); knee = flex (shin swings back); elbow = flex forward; torso/head 0 = upright, + = lean forward

run.timing: on twos: 16 frames = 0.667 s stride; near leg leads 0-3; contact/down/pass/up

pose_sets.climb: pp.climb_pose(k, step_top) k=0..3: near foot pinned at step_top (contact plane = tile top), hip solved by analytic 2-bone IK (pp.ik_leg); step 128 px right, 96 px up

replacements.laugh_cycle: 1-4-5-4-6-4..., 4 frames per mouth (exposure sheet in build/test-results.json)
replacements.note: r3: mouths 5/6 opened wider (w 240/246, open 74/98 px at 2x) with the same soft single gap-tooth strip; 2 = gasp (two front teeth), 7 = O

spring_params.fringe: 10 strands x 3 segments (roots along the parting, rest sweep to the right temple; the gust rotates strands 4-8 down across the right eye)
spring_params.slivers: 9 flyaways past the silhouette at top right, 2 detach

tests.labels: measured: lag, decay, root pin, state restore, FK closure (limb_detach_max_px), climb pin error, limit clamps, centroid delta, head width; perceptual (pending independent reviewer): 'reads as laughing with sound off'

test_shot.span: film 6.0-10.0 s (96 frames); jump cut at film frame 192 (local 48); declared hold 7.667-8.000 s
test_shot.plates: U2 forage/P1_sharp.png, P2_sharp.png (graded by U2), upscaled 2x and Gaussian-defocused here (r 12 @720; P2 rack to r 3.5 at 9.0-10.0 s); P2 further desaturated x0.72 and darkened x0.92 here (user note: Clichy saturation down) and framed so the native tram is at frame right
test_shot.sound: as r2: Commons wind gust (SAgbley, CC BY-SA 4.0) + kit-synthesized murmur/bell/steps/snap; declared silence 7.667-8.000 s
user_notes_addressed: laugh opened wider, soft gap-tooth kept (mouths 5/6)
fringe strands 4-8 sweep across the right eye on the gust (see stills/01.60.png)
layered hair mass, softer face and grey-olive P1 kept
Clichy plate saturation pulled down (P2 plate HSV-S ~28 vs ~54 in U2's grade)

rejected.reason: shows magazine spines, not a paper surface
photograph of a person; not a paper scan

printed advertisement, no blank area of use
excluded: real child, user rule (not opened, not used)

handmade.item: cut-paper puppet Z: CU head rig (bob 3 under-tones + 4 panels + 10 slivers, crown cap, 10 spring strands + 9 flyaways, side locks, ears w/ inner shade, face sheet, jaw/socket tissue, risen tissue cheeks, brows, eyes x3 replacements, folded nose tab, upper/lower lips, 6+ mouths w/ gap-tooth upper strip, neck, 2-tone orange collar, brown jumper, brass split pin)
full-figure body: torso, skirt, thighs, shins (socks), shoes, upper arms, forearms, hands, thumbs (near/far), profile head with bob, cap, fringe, slivers, eye and mouth replacements, collar
14 letter tiles DOUKIPUDONKTAN (DejaVu Serif Bold glyph as the scissor line, red-brown kraft letter on cream 1929 paper) + feet variants
métro sign with GRÈVE strip; PLACE DE CLICHY and PLACE DU CHÂTELET enamel plaques (card); 6 mouth-tunnel rings

gaps: no PD/CC0 tissue-paper scan found; thin book paper stands in
profile head for full-figure shots is simpler than the CU head (no spring strands; hair secondary is a single 'hair' parameter the editor drives from a spring)
métro sign: GRÈVE strip covers most of MÉTRO (intended gag, but editor may want the strip lower)
'reads as laughing sound-off' is self-judged only; independent review pending
full test-shot sound not re-auditioned (unchanged from r2)
